PURE - People for Urban and Rural Education Trust PURE works to create equitable access to education, life skills, health awareness, and community development opportunities for underserved children, youth, women, and families. Bronze Certified 2023 80G 12A CSR-1 Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Education Child & Youth Development Skill Development Secondary Sectors Vocational Training Scholarships Financials Geographies Served Programs PURE Abhyasa State Telangana States Telangana PURE Abhyasa focuses on community-based and bridge learning support for children who need additional educational assistance. The program supports children through learning resources, structured academic support, digital tools, nutrition-linked support where applicable, and community engagement to help them stay connected to education. PURE Schools State Andhra Pradesh West Bengal Uttar Pradesh Telangana States Andhra Pradesh West Bengal Uttar Pradesh Telangana PURE Schools supports underserved students and schools by improving access to learning resources, school supplies, digital education, academic support, and safe learning environments. The program helps children continue their education with dignity and gives schools the support they need to create better learning outcomes. PURE Youth HUbs State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka West Bengal Maharashtra Telangana States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka West Bengal Maharashtra Telangana PURE Youth Hubs create leadership and service opportunities for young people. Through these hubs, youth volunteers plan and lead community service projects, awareness drives, school support activities, and social impact initiatives. The program helps young people build leadership, empathy, responsibility, teamwork, and civic engagement. PURE Femme State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka West Bengal Telangana States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka West Bengal Telangana PURE Femme supports women and adolescent girls through health awareness programs focused on menstrual health, hygiene, breast health, cervical health, and preventive wellness. The program works to reduce stigma, improve awareness, and help women and girls make informed health decisions with dignity. PURE Academy State Andhra Pradesh Telangana States Andhra Pradesh Telangana PURE Academy is a skill development and learning initiative that supports youth, women, and underserved learners with practical training, life skills, employability readiness, and career-oriented learning opportunities. The program focuses on helping participants build confidence, communication skills, digital awareness, workplace readiness, and practical capabilities that can improve their access to employment, entrepreneurship, and long-term self-reliance. Through structured sessions, mentoring, workshops, and community-based learning, PURE Academy helps bridge the gap between education and opportunity for individuals who need skill-based support to move forward with dignity and confidence. Milestones & Track Record Educated over 400,000 children, transformed more than 4,000 classrooms, and equipped over 450,000 girls with health resources. --> --> Leadership Team Sandhya Gollamudi Managing Trustee Sujatha Voorakaranam Trustee Yashomitra Yerramilli Trustee Santhisri Koganti General Manager Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AADTP0002A Registration Number 125/2016 CSR Form 1 CSR00019583. VO ID / Darpan ID TS/2017/0176907 --> 80G AADTP0002AF20172 12A AADTP0002AE20172 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Hyderabad, Telangana Since 2016 Demographies Served Youth Children --> Impact PURE creates measurable change by improving access to education, health awareness, youth leadership, and community support for underserved children, youth, women, and families. Through its programs, PURE has supported students with learning resources, digital education, school-based initiatives, and community learning opportunities. PURE Youth Hubs have enabled young people to take leadership roles, serve their communities, and build confidence, responsibility, and life skills. PURE’s health awareness programs have helped women and girls gain knowledge around menstrual health, hygiene, breast health, cervical health, and preventive wellness. PURE’s impact goes beyond one-time support. Our work helps children stay connected to learning, helps young people become community leaders, helps girls and women access health awareness with dignity, and helps communities build stronger foundations for long-term growth. Vision and Mission PURE aims to be a bridge connecting individuals, groups and organizations with the urgent needs of the world's children.
